title: Render props: let the parent decide what to draw

slides.say: What if a component knows the data, but the parent should decide how it looks? That's a render prop.
A render prop is a function prop that returns UI. List loops over the items, and calls render item to draw each one.
The parent passes that function. Same List, but each screen can draw the items its own way.
The name doesn't matter. Some libraries use children as the function, like this mouse tracker.

slides.text: For sharing stateful logic, custom Hooks replaced most render props. They still shine for custom item rendering.
slides.say: For sharing stateful logic, custom Hooks have replaced most render props. But for letting a parent customize how items look, they're still handy.
